findings.body: fetchState races $.http.fetch against $.clock.after(2000); on 'timeout' it returns {kind:'down'} and finally only cancels the timer. Authority states fetch has no timeout option. poll's isPolling guard blocks overlapping poll() entry but not prior raced fetches still pending. [plugins/dopemux-pulse/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED in register.tsx fetchState/poll; host fetch lifetime UNKNOWN. Operator accepted this as a disclosed residual risk in chat on 2026-10-22 ("Accept F1 as a disclosed residual risk. Keep the audited head."); no repair, no re-audit.
findings.title: Timed-out polls leave $.http.fetch promises running; a hung engine can accumulate unbounded in-flight GETs (one per minute) because Promise.race does not cancel fetch.
